label: Text to File
description: Store a piece of text as a file and emit the file reference. For text that is too big to travel between nodes as a value (a wire carries at most 100 KB), or that a node wants as a file (an upload, an attachment, a conversation an LLM node keeps in a file). The file is plain text unless `mimeType` says otherwise (`application/json` for a JSON document). To read a text file back, use FileToText.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The text to store, saved as UTF-8.

inputs.name: filename
inputs.label: Filename
inputs.description: The name the file is stored under (what a download calls it).

inputs.name: mimeType
inputs.label: Media type
inputs.description: The file's media type: `text/plain`, `text/markdown`, `text/csv`, `application/json`, and so on.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.label: Store in
inputs.description: `execution`: the file belongs to this run, and only this run can read it. `project`: it belongs to the project, and every later run can read it.

inputs.name: ttl_days
inputs.label: Keep for (days, 0 = forever)
inputs.description: How long the file lives once nobody touches it: any access (read, download, presign) resets the clock, and 0 means never expire. Empty means an execution file is swept shortly after its run ends, and a project file lives until deleted.

outputs.name: filename
outputs.description: The name the file is stored under.
